Name: Vibrant Hair
Author: lakoria
Description:
[center][img]http://i.imgur.com/ns77I97.jpg[/img]
This is a simple edit to the player's hair to make colors much brighter. Available in two vibrancy levels: [b]mild[/b] and [b]ultra[/b]. Please see images for differences. [/center]

[b]INSTALLATION:[/b]
1. Download [b]mild[/b] [i]or[/i] [b]ultra[/b]. You cannot use both at the same time.
2. Create a back-up of the original hairstyles.xnb file, just in case you want to revert back to the default hair in the future.
3. Extract hairstyles.xnb to your Stardew Valley\Content\Characters\Farmer directory, allow file to be overwritten.
4. Play!

This mod is NOT compatible with any other mods that edit hairstyles.xnb. If you need any help, please let me know!
